svg.title: How a scenario reaches an OpenAEV platform
svg.desc: OpenAEV agents and people open pull requests on OpenAEV-Platform/scenarios. Every pull request is checked automatically, reviewed by a person, then released by a maintainer on the edge channel. The collector at the customer checks every file and syncs it to the OpenAEV Marketplace.
svg.text: One frozen file per version, one ID for all versions
